high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a tweet from the Twitter account @MAstronomers, which is verified by a blue checkmark. The tweet commemorates 10 years since NASA's New Horizons spacecraft captured an extraordinary view of Pluto's surface. The text reads: "10 years ago, NASA's New Horizons captured this extraordinary view of the frozen plains and majestic mountains on the surface of Pluto." The image accompanying the tweet is a black-and-white photograph showing a rugged, icy landscape with what appears to be frozen plains and towering mountains.
